question.text: Under SEBI's classification of Fixed Income mutual funds, bonds with Macaulay Duration of MORE than 7 years are categorised as:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI MF classification: <3 yrs Short, 3–7 yrs Mid, >7 yrs Long Duration. The Trap: Students often confuse with 'medium-term' which can overlap loosely; SEBI's bands are strict. Cross-Exam Context: V-A and V-B cover MF classification basics; XXI-B applies in PMS construction. Manager's Pro-Tip: PMS doesn't have the same SEBI label-mandate as MFs, but PMs still use these bands when writing disclosure docs for investor clarity.
